name: Structured Document Extraction
summary: Invoices, receipts, and forms become typed rows with per-field confidence and a human-review queue.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ENDPOINT
env.description: Object Storage endpoint. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Object Storage access key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Object Storage secret key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
env.description: AI Gateway credential. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: EXTRACT_MODEL
env.description: Vision-capable model. Must accept image input.

env.name: EXTRACT_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
env.description: Fields below this confidence queue for human review. Measure against your own corpus before trusting a value; model confidence is uncalibrated.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

triggers.description: Extract structured fields from an uploaded document.
Required by §5. Retries failures and picks up documents the trigger never delivered.
